column1: # RDR-229 P3.5b (nexus-p2m1x.24): what P3.5b does with each reader of p35b-reader-census.tsv, one row per (kind, object, name_column).
# Hand-kept; tests/test_rdr229_p35b_reader_census.py fails while a census reader has no row, a row names no census reader, or a row breaks its rule.
#   id             redefined to read the id column instead of the name column (form A: a CONTINUE-gated changeset on the stamp moves)
#   both           redefined to match by the id where both sides carry one and by the name where either lacks one (form B only); P4.1 removes the name arm
#   label-kept     keeps reading the registry label on purpose: only for name_column catalog_collections.name, with a one-line reason (linda 2026-11-22)
#   parse-removed  the name-parsing expression (split_part on '__', a 'quarantine-' prefix) is removed
#   writer-kept    left on the name only to stamp an id on a write P3.1 made (form A, the object is a SQL writer in p31-writer-census.tsv); P4.1 redefines the writers
#   name-kept      a form-B search function P3.5b leaves on its last definer's name path until P4.1, so its plans, per-collection index use and
#                  sensitive anti join stay as they are; its id path is the twin named in the reason (<object>_by_id), which P3.5c calls after gate 3 (linda 2026-11-22)
#   no-caller      a form B function with no engine caller: kept on its name path, no id twin, dropped at P4.1
#   child-name-stamp  a vectors-079 row trigger (RDR-229 P3.7) that reads chunks.collection, and resolves the chunk's superseded_by, to stamp a
#                  child row's name; dropped with the name keys at P4.1 (linda 2026-11-23)
#   unchanged-fallback  a reader P3.5b leaves on its last definer because it has no match to redefine (an output-only or an id-first read); needs a reason
#   id-twin        an id-path twin <object>_by_id vectors-077 adds: it matches by collection_id only; the name column it reads is its RETURNS name, as the
# A NULL id is no collection: an id or both reader never falls back to a '' name (linda 2026-11-20).
